# Implement free market re-roll mechanic (engine + state + bias draw)

**Summary:** Add the engine logic for the Investor's free market re-roll: per-turn state tracking, the bias-aware draw algorithm, and the integration with the existing market refill path.

## Acceptance Criteria

- While at least one Investor is employed, the player may perform one coin-free, action-free market re-roll per week/turn (no coin deduction, no action spent); multiple Investors do not stack (still one per turn). The free re-roll is gated by a per-turn flag reset at `WeekStart` alongside `peekUsedThisTurn`/`favourUsedThisTurn`, and it advances the per-turn escalation counter (`marketRefreshesThisTurn`, MS-0MTR6ZRF5007PWNZ) so the next paid re-roll costs the escalated price. Once used, further re-rolls fall back to the normal paid path.
- On the Investor's free re-roll, each drawn slot has a 75% chance to be drawn from the "relevant" pool for the business the Investor is employed at, falling back to the fully random pool when the relevant pool is exhausted; the remaining probability is entirely random. Relevance is defined as a shared synergy type (business/community-space synergyTypes; event targetSynergy/effect; staff allowedBusinessTypes overlap with the hosting business's synergy types).
- The biased draw uses the seeded RNG (`state.rng`) so same-seed produces same-game determinism.
- `refillSingleRowMarket` is parameterised to accept the bias/relevance pool; the normal `refreshMarket`/`cycleMarketCards` paths stay fully random.
- The bias draw preserves the >=1-business row composition invariant.

**Parent Coverage:** Implements parent AC2 (One free re-roll per turn) and parent AC3 (Relevance bias).

**Minimal Implementation:**
- Add `investorFreeRerollUsedThisTurn` to state types
- Reset flag at `WeekStart`
- Implement `canUseFreeMarketReroll` / `useFreeMarketReroll`
- Implement bias-aware draw in `refillSingleRowMarket`
- Wire up the bias detection (hosting business synergy types overlap)

**Dependencies:** Add Investor card to catalog (CSV + types + parsing)

**Deliverables:** Engine functions, state field, bias draw algorithm, WeekStart reset.

**Key Files:**
- `src/MainStreetStateTypes.ts`
- `src/MainStreetEngineWeekStart.ts`
- `src/MainStreetMarketRefill.ts`
- `src/MainStreetStateSetup.ts`
- `src/MainStreetStaffBuffs.ts` or `src/MainStreetStaffSkills.ts`
data.title: Implement free market re-roll mechanic (engine + state + bias draw)

# Implement staff movement (1-action-point relocation)

**Summary:** Add a player-facing "move staff" action that relocates a hired staff member from one business to another, consuming 1 action point. The initial placement at hire time remains action-free.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Relocating a hired staff member from one business to another is exposed as a player action and consumes 1 action point for all staff (the existing `placeStaffOnBusiness` placement is action-free today and must be action-gated when used as a relocation; the initial placement at hire time remains part of the hire action). The move respects `allowedBusinessTypes` and employment-slot capacity, is undoable, and is persisted.

**Parent Coverage:** Implements parent AC4 — All staff relocation costs an action point.

**Minimal Implementation:**
- Add `moveStaffOnBusiness` engine function in `MainStreetEngineCommands.ts`
- Add `moveStaffCommand` in `MainStreetCommands.ts` gated at 1 action point
- Wire up the UI affordance in the market scene
- Update placement tests to account for the new action cost on relocation

**Dependencies:** None (can be developed in parallel with the free re-roll mechanic)

**Deliverables:** Engine function, command, UI affordance, test updates.

**Key Files:**
- `src/MainStreetEngineCommands.ts`
- `src/MainStreetCommands.ts`
- `src/scenes/MainStreetRendererMarket.ts`
- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerMarketActions.ts`
- `tests/main-street/staff-business-type-matching.test.ts`
- `tests/main-street/action-economy.test.ts`

# Add serialization support for new state fields

**Summary:** Ensure all new state fields introduced by the Investor card feature are correctly serialised, deserialised, and migrated (with backfill) so that save/load works across version boundaries.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The per-turn free-re-roll flag, the per-turn escalation counter it increments (`marketRefreshesThisTurn`), and the Investor's location participate in undo/redo (`snapshotAction`) and in `MainStreetStateSerialize` (serialize + migrate backfill + deserialize), so mid-turn reload preserves both availability and the escalated next price.
- The bias draw uses the seeded RNG (`state.rng`) so same-seed produces same-game determinism.

**Parent Coverage:** Implements the save/load and undo aspects of parent AC6 — Undo, save/load and determinism.

**Minimal Implementation:**
- Add field to serialized state type
- Update `MainStreetStateSerialize` serialise/deserialise paths
- Add backfill in `migrateSerializedState`
- Verify undo/redo captures the new state fields

**Dependencies:** Add Investor card to catalog (CSV + types + parsing), Implement free market re-roll mechanic

**Deliverables:** Updated serializer, migration function, undo/redo coverage.

**Key Files:**
- `src/MainStreetStateTypes.ts`
- `src/MainStreetStateSerialize.ts`
- `src/MainStreetEngineCommands.ts`
data.title: Add serialization support for new state fields

# Update UI and tooltips for free re-roll and staff movement

**Summary:** Surface the Investor's free re-roll availability and the 75% relevance bias in the UI through tooltip text, button labels, and the employed-staff summary. Also add the move-staff affordance.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The market re-roll button/tooltip and the Investor's staff tooltip/employed-staff summary surface whether the free re-roll is still available this turn and the 75% relevance bias. The button label/tooltip reflect the coin-free state when available and the escalated cost when not. Wording stays consistent with the MS-0MTIS895Y008XGQ1 "Research" rename if that lands first.
- A move-staff affordance is exposed that shows the 1-action-point cost.

**Parent Coverage:** Implements parent AC5 — UI & tooltips.

**Minimal Implementation:**
- Update `MainStreetRendererMarket.ts` — re-roll button label/state
- Update `MainStreetTurnControllerMarketActions.ts` — free re-roll button handler
- Update `MainStreetHudTooltips.ts` — tooltip text for free re-roll availability
- Update `MainStreetFormatting.ts` — employed-staff summary line for Investor ability
- Add move-staff affordance in the market scene

**Dependencies:** Implement free market re-roll mechanic (engine + state + bias draw), Implement staff movement

**Deliverables:** Updated UI components, tooltips, employed-staff summary text.

**Key Files:**
- `src/scenes/MainStreetRendererMarket.ts`
- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerMarketActions.ts`
- `src/scenes/MainStreetHudTooltips.ts`
- `src/MainStreetFormatting.ts`

# Add comprehensive tests for Investor staff abilities

**Summary:** Write unit and integration tests covering the Investor card's catalog entry, the free re-roll mechanic (coin-free, once per turn, escalation counter), the 75% relevance bias, staff movement action cost, undo/redo, and save/load round-trip.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Unit/integration tests cover: catalog + CSV contract; free re-roll is coin-free, once per turn, resets at `WeekStart` and advances the escalation counter; the 75% relevance bias (deterministic with a seeded RNG) and its random fallback; movement action cost + undo + save/load round-trip; and existing re-roll/discount/action-economy tests are updated for the new card and counts.
- Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

**Parent Coverage:** Implements parent AC7 (Tests) and parent AC9 (Quality gate). Also supports parent AC6 (undo, save/load) with save/load round-trip tests.

**Minimal Implementation:**
- Create `tests/main-street/investor-staff.test.ts` with the above cases
- Update `tests/main-street/refresh-market.test.ts` for free re-roll and escalation
- Update `tests/main-street/group-f-staff-abilities-expansion.test.ts` (staff count 25 -> 26)
- Update `tests/main-street/meta-progression.test.ts` (166/174 totals)
- Update `tests/main-street/staff-business-type-matching.test.ts`, `card-art.test.ts`, `hud-tooltips.test.ts`, `action-economy.test.ts` for the new card and movement cost

**Dependencies:** All implementation features (test-first ordering means tests may be written alongside/before implementation)

**Deliverables:** New test file, updated existing tests, passing full suite.

# Advance re-roll escalation counter on free re-roll

**Summary:** Coordinate with the escalating re-roll cost work item (MS-0MTR6ZRF5007PWNZ) to ensure the Investor's free re-roll advances the shared per-turn escalation counter, preventing a desynchronised displayed price.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The free re-roll increments marketRefreshesThisTurn (the same counter used by the paid path), so the next paid re-roll costs the escalated price. The displayed re-roll cost after a free re-roll matches refreshMarketCost(state).
- refreshMarketCost() remains the single source of truth for the paid path.
- The two work items are linked via a dependency edge or cross-reference comment.

**Parent Coverage:** Supports parent AC1 (One free re-roll per turn) - ensures escalation counter is advanced.

**Minimal Implementation:**
- Increment marketRefreshesThisTurn in useFreeMarketReroll
- Add a test asserting the escalated price after a free re-roll
- Comment on MS-0MTR6ZRF5007PWNZ confirming the decision

**Deliverables:** Counter increment, test, cross-reference comments.

**Key Files:**
- src/MainStreetMarketRefill.ts
- tests/main-street/investor-staff.test.ts
data.title: Advance re-roll escalation counter on free re-roll
